name: Magazine cover
oneLiner: a glossy magazine cover assembles around the brand photo (the person rises into a paper sweep, an invented Didone masthead sets letter by letter behind their head, coverlines and the cover-star name slide in), then the camera pulls back to a walnut desk and the new issue drops onto older issues as the laminate gloss runs across it
say: when the speaker says someone made the cover, got featured or became the story ('imagine being the cover story', 'this is who you become'): the cover builds on the setup and the issue drops on the desk on the payoff
